structure_explanation.en: Here we have the target 〜くする for real: the i-adjective 水くさい ('cold, distant, overly formal with someone close') becomes the adverbial form 水くさく and joins する, forming 水くさくする = 'to act distant/reserved, to treat with formality'. The adverb そう ('so, that way') intensifies, and the final particle な (on a verb in dictionary form) is the prohibition: 'don't do (it)'.

O advérbio そう ('tão, desse jeito') intensifica, e a partícula final な (em verbo na forma de dicionário) é a proibição: 'não faça'.

ops.issue: センス means (aesthetic/fashion) sense, taste — not 'common sense' (常識). lit_en contradicts both the jp and the natural en ('fashion sense') and teaches a wrong equivalence.

before.jp: センスが全然ないわ。
before.kana: せんすがぜんぜんないわ。

structure_explanation.en: The sentence applies the target pattern 全然〜ない (zenzen~nai, 'not... at all'): 全然 sets up the total negation that materializes in ない. The subject センス ('sense, good taste') is marked by が, and ない expresses nonexistence ('there's no sense at all'). The final particle わ adds a soft/expressive nuance, frequent in feminine speech.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: A frase aplica o padrão alvo 全然〜ない (zenzen~nai, 'não... de jeito nenhum'): 全然 prepara a negação total que se concretiza em ない. O sujeito センス ('senso, bom gosto') é marcado por が, e ない expressa a inexistência ('não há senso algum'). A partícula final わ acrescenta nuance suave/expressiva, frequente na fala feminina.
